resources.string: Gamblock-AI reads the URL bar, title, headings, and link text in Chrome and Edge for local classification and shows an intervention when gambling content is detected. URLs and page text are never sent to the backend.

Gamblock-AI uses Accessibility Service in the background to read the URL bar, title, headings, and link text in Chrome and Edge. This data is classified only on your device. When gambling content is detected, the app navigates Back and shows a Pattern Interrupt.\n\nURLs, domains, and page text are never sent to the backend. The backend can receive only aggregate protection counts according to your sharing choices.
